title: appendix-ccp12-hopping.md:84,159,303: NChannels < 3 produces invalid channel indices
description: The formula N = MAX(NChannels - 1, 2) followed by 1 + (Hash MOD N) returns invalid channel indices when NChannels < 3. For NChannels=2, can return channel 2 (only 0-1 exist). For NChannels=1, returns 1 or 2 (only 0 exists). For NChannels=0 with unsigned arithmetic, underflows to 255 and returns channels up to 255. This would cause transmissions on non-existent channels. Same bug at line 84 (CCP-16), line 159 (CCP-12 SynchronizedHopChannel), and line 303 (Python reference). Fix: Add guard IF NChannels < 3 THEN RETURN 0 before the hash computation.
